question: What's our position on BES Cyber System categorization?
answer:
Our position on BES Cyber System categorization is defined by a structured, top-down process that utilizes the ERO Enterprise-Endorsed Implementation Guidance (CIP-002-5.1a) as its methodology [cite O-af5e84].

The process is executed in several distinct stages:

**1. Identification and Impact Rating of BES Facilities**
Transmission Planning, in consultation with Transmission System Operations, identifies BES Facilities and assigns impact ratings using the criteria from Attachment 1 of the CIP-002-5.1a standard [cite O-66e4a8]. The ratings are applied in a specific order to account for dependencies:
*   **Medium Impact:** Generation and Transmission facilities (criteria 2.1 – 2.10) [cite O-66e4a8].
*   **High Impact:** Control Centers (criteria 1.1 – 1.4) [cite O-66e4a8].
*   **Medium Impact:** Selected Control Centers (criteria 2.11 – 2.13) [cite O-66e4a8].
*   **Low Impact:** All remaining BES Facilities [cite O-66e4a8].

**2. Cyber Asset Identification and Categorization**
Once the facilities are rated, OT Security & Compliance performs the following [cite O-66e4a8]:
*   **Inventory Establishment:** For High and Medium Impact BES Assets, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) establish an inventory of associated candidate Cyber Assets.
*   **BES Cyber Asset Determination:** SMEs determine if each candidate Cyber Asset meets the definition of a "BES Cyber Asset" by evaluating whether the "loss, degradation, misoperation, or compromise of the Cyber Asset would have an Adverse Impact on the BES within 15 minutes" [cite O-66e4a8].
*   **Grouping and Documentation:** The process includes grouping these assets into BES Cyber Systems [cite O-66e4a8] and documenting the results in OTAM1. The documentation must include specific details such as the Cyber Asset Name, Impact Rating, BES Cyber System ID, IP Address, and Operating System [cite O-66e4a8].

**3. Ancillary Asset Identification**
The process also requires determining the associated Electronic Access Control and Monitoring Systems (EACMS), Physical Access Control Systems (PACS), and Protected Cyber Assets (PCA) for each identified BES Cyber System [cite O-66e4a8].

For any Low Impact BES Asset identified, the process includes a specific step to determine if that asset has any associated Cyber Assets that meet the definition of BES Cyber Assets [cite O-66e4a8].

Quoted sources:
- "The BES Cyber System Identification and Categorization Process is comprised of the following main elements, which are generally performed in the order presented. Some steps may, however, be performed in parallel. LSPG, taking a top-down approach, utilizes the ERO Enterprise-Endorsed Implementation Guidance: CIP-002-5.1a R1 Identify and Categorize BES Cyber Systems and Cyber Assets (MRO SC) as the basis for its CIP-002 methodology." (O-af5e84 — BES Cyber System Categorization Process, 3.1)
- "Step 4: Categorize the identified BES Facilities utilizing the output from the previous step to those entries that qualify as BES Facilities in sequential steps, using Attachment 1 of the CIP-002-5.1a standard document. • Medium (Generation and Transmission facilities criteria 2.1 – 2.10) • High (Control Centers criteria 1.1 – 1.4) • Medium (selected Control Centers criteria 2.11 – 2.13) • Low (Remaining BES Facilities)" (O-66e4a8 — BES Cyber System Categorization Process, 3.4.1)
- "For each BES Asset identified in Step 4 above, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) will establish an inventory of the candidate Cyber Assets associated with High and Medium Impact BES Assets and determine whether each Cyber Asset meets the CIP definition of “BES Cyber Asset.” This determination is made by considering whether the loss, degradation, misoperation, or compromise of the Cyber Asset would have an Adverse Impact on the BES within 15 minutes." (O-66e4a8 — BES Cyber System Categorization Process, 3.4.2.1)
- "Determine the associated Electronic Access Control and Monitoring Systems (EACMS), Physical Access Control Systems (PACS), and Protected Cyber Assets (PCA) with each BES Cyber System." (O-66e4a8 — BES Cyber System Categorization Process, 3.4.2.4)
- "Document the list within OTAM1 and include the following information. • Cyber Asset Name • Classification (BES Cyber Asset, EACMS, PACS, PCA) • Impact Rating • BES Cyber System ID • Asset ID • IP Address • Function • Manufacturer • Model • Connectivity • Operating System" (O-66e4a8 — BES Cyber System Categorization Process, 3.4.2.6)
- "For any Low Impact BES Asset identified, LSPG will determine whether the asset has any associated Cyber Assets that meet the definition of BES Cyber Assets." (O-66e4a8 — BES Cyber System Categorization Process, 3.4.3)
